title: Autopilot can offer a new unanswered merge card after a verified failed card when a different head passes fresh six gates
acceptance: Why and boundary. PR237 T254 old card D-firstmate-workflow-T254-3 was captain A on H0=636004a42a2e842fdd1a0a02b9b3365ec6509f99 and settled failed under strict base protection. New H1=d8e573e4272798114454b77d1ebda40a8a27372e passed all six stock gates and has signed readiness25c93cedf37c3de4487ecad319516fb3e9c94dc689f34d0118d1adf36bce9e80 on basefeb2d6af2470f787939feac923afcc7308f1cce8. Gate jobfc50e67af8dbc8e2be7b2b3a236201d4 code0 was consumed/done, but merge_card scans all pending/decisions and returns for any old merge record, including failed history. No allocation/details wake occurs. This task restores new card availability after an exact different head, without retrying the old answer, carrying approval or merging.

T220 immutable supplied boundary evidence. The exact retained accepted T220 source SHA256 is 08f497bc0ba1ddb360f8075eb5d2d9f69adb788924749fd39815f3c0e902867b; scope is ["bin/fm-merge.sh", "bin/fm-cleanup.sh", "bin/lib/fm_binding.py", "bin/lib/fm-carry-base.sh", "board/server.ts", "skills/firstmate/SKILL.md", "tests/**", "design/design.md", "design/tasks/T-220.json"]. Its acceptance states verbatim: Out of scope: syncing the local base outside a carry wait (firstmate's step otherwise); a head-independent identity for external reviews (external-policy projects keep refusing a moved head, with the reason above); fm-merge updating the PR branch, rerunning CI or running gates itself; carrying across a new worker commit or a new review; carrying an untracked card; carrying an answer for a stacked PR whose base is another task branch (Change 3 refuses it at once, before any wait or sync); any change to autopilot scheduling; changing what gate 6 accepts.. This quote is supplied normative boundary evidence, available inline even when T220 is absent from isolated checkout; reviewers do not need a mutable external reference. Loop scheduling is excluded, so T269 is distinct. T269 formal reservation/dispatch authorization remains captain/root stock responsibility, separate from this implementation acceptance; candidate filename never allocates a task.

Eligibility and trust. Apply only tracked land:card task PRs whose prior card belongs to exact project/task/PR with valid owned ID/file identity, chosen A, modern merge=failed, retained merge_settled and known expected_head H0. Resolve recognized outcome through existing fm_merge_outcome semantics but automatic replacement requires explicit modern failed, not a guessed legacy/falsy/missing outcome. Match retained captain decision_made settlement event by identity/project default rules/task/id/chosen A/failed outcome and H0. Verify old binding.signature against integrity-verified Store signed readiness for exact old project/task/PR/repository/H0, without requiring stale old readiness to be current. Missing/forged signatures, malformed mismatched identities, absent settlement evidence, unknown outcome, conflicting records or missing old head hold with a bounded bilingual reason; no signature fabricated. Matching board-owned records/events are retained local provenance, not new cryptographic captain signatures. Do not strengthen claim beyond existing stored evidence.

New head prerequisite. Require authoritative OPEN PR H1 valid commit SHA and H1 != every superseded qualifying failed-card H0. Same-head failures hold; no retry on each timer, no auto-update branch/CI, and no approval carried from old A. Any matching pending card, running/unknown merge, successful settled merge, unanswered/held B/C/custom decision still holds or existing landed logic suppresses work. Any foreign project/task/PR record does not authorize replacement; existing project merge-turn and blocker semantics remain. Any unknown relevant history remains conservative. No head-independent or untracked-card expansion.

Scheduling and existing consumed results. Add a minimal deterministic verified failure-replacement evidence component to existing advance fingerprint, derived from qualifying old decision identity/head/settlement and current authoritative H1. It is scheduling evidence only. This changes pre-upgrade already-consumed fingerprint exactly once, allowing ordinary protocol/gate scheduling to rerun on current H1 and reach code0 merge_card; never call merge_card directly from cached CI or replay completed job. Existing in-flight same task job remains busy; uncertain job remains reconciliation dependency. Repeated unchanged poll/restart must not start additional gate or duplicate card. Do not add generic action ledger, erase advanced/jobs, or restart supervisor to force result consumption. When NO trusted replacement eligibility exists, retain existing seven-element fingerprint input byte-equivalent: do not append null/empty marker or alter keys/order/values. Add consumed ordinary-task upgrade regression proving no regate with identical ordinary inputs. Only qualifying replacement appends the defined deterministic component. Positive migration remains one normal gate for a qualifying old failed card.

Card publication. Only a fresh ordinary gate code0 completion may invoke replacement through existing merge_card. Under existing merge-turn lock, reread current base/head, old trusted failure eligibility and all holds, require current signed six-gate readiness for H1, selected review and fresh required checks through unchanged stock candidate/request checks at publication. Allocate a NEW stock card ID through existing allocator; preserve failed old card, answer, reason, binding, events and counters byte-for-byte. No moving/renaming/deleting old decisions, resetting final outcomes or reusing old chosen A. Current authored details wins; otherwise existing self builder/explicit external authored details behavior stays, with actionable reserved-ID details wake. All existing rendering/STE/card publication checks apply. New card is unanswered and binds H1/new readiness; only captain new board response authorizes merge.

Races and idempotency, bounded cooperation contract. Under existing merge-turn.lock recheck failure settlement/head/base and known project blocker; this serializes cooperating MechanicalLoop/shared merge-turn callers ONLY. Direct fm-decide requests and board merge startup use their existing per-ID/running checks, do not share this lock, and external GitHub mutations are not globally excluded. Do not claim atomic global exclusion. If competing pending card/merge is visible at either existing reread, hold; if it appears after that check the preserved stock request/candidate checks and final merge match-head remain the independent refusal boundaries, without new cross-writer guarantee. Tests inject a visible cooperating blocker and assert no publication, and separately a mutation after precheck that stock candidate refuses; describe the actual observable boundaries. Any head/base race defers/regates normally. Reserved ID stays stable across retries, while eventual publication binds THEN-CURRENT valid readiness chosen by unchanged stock candidate; reservation does not retain a readiness signature. A new valid same-H1 signed readiness may replace an earlier signature before publication; test reuse ID/current binding plus refusal when updated evidence is invalid. Preserve old history bytes and no duplicate new pending card. Same H1 failure cannot spin; another distinct head plus fresh gates may offer another unanswered card.

Tests and real base-red proof. Extend actual autopilot-loop fixture through job_completed/consume_jobs/advance to start with old failed card, matching captain settlement event and actual signed readiness Store; use mocked GitHub/owned synthetic repository only. Assert full code0 result creates new pending H1 card once, actual old JSON/events unchanged, --expected-head current, no gh merge/board answer and new chosen absent. Fail-first on exact prior runtime retains complete harness/APIs and valid fixture authority; expected new pending card absent is concrete red, not import/missing-setup failure. Independently test already-consumed old-code advance fingerprint migrates via new evidence component into normal one gate scheduling, then fresh successful result creates card; repeated poll/restart no duplicate. Preserve existing gate6 review launch/failures/landed and missing-details reserved-ID reuse tests.

Negative matrix, two distinct boundaries. Pre-request eligibility holds: same-head failed, pending/running/merged/B/C/custom, missing/unknown/legacy outcomes, corrupt/missing old signed readiness, missing/conflicting settlement, mismatched identity/project/task/PR/head, or visible merge-slot hold; assert zero replacement-request invocation, zero published card/merge and unchanged historical records. Stock request validation refusals: stale/red/pending current CI, missing/invalid then-current readiness or selected review, and head/base races detected inside stock candidate; request invocation is permitted, but assert no published replacement/no merge and unchanged old history. Missing external authored details intentionally permits stock ID reservation and bilingual diagnostic wake, no request or publication; invalid details/request failure may likewise preserve reserved ID/wake. New reservations/diagnostics are allowed where existing stock lifecycle intends; never demand zero all-state mutation there. All cases preserve prior failed-answer finality, successful/card holds, adopted ownership, project isolation, monotonic allocator and active lifeline jobs. No real GitHub writes/vendor sessions.

Docs and migration. Update existing design §15.8 autopilot advancement/merge turn and §5.2 final decision semantics in place, docs/autopilot advancement fingerprints, firstmate merge-card handling: failed remains final; different head after corrected cause/fresh review/CI/gates can get NEW unanswered card. Old code roots keep prior hold; updated supervisor uses normal stock self-update/reload drain preserving live jobs. No stored card/evidence/pin format migration, historical archive or manual state reset. Existing already-consumed successful gate does not immediately create card solely on upgrade: ordinary new fingerprint stock gate revalidation precedes publication. T220 carry behavior remains separate and does not resurrect failed A.

Out of scope. No automatic merge/answer/approval carry, no same-head retry or scheduled broad mutation, no manual card deletion/history rewrite, no runtime/gate6/candidate weakening, no protected-base bypass, no external renderer overhaul, no CI sleeps/skip, no live-job interruption. Worker syntax/static only per contract; firstmate/reviewer declaredsetup before suite/check. If trusting legacy records or new schema is required, stop with exact scope/semantic request rather than silently expanding.

External privacy regression. In synthetic FM_EXTERNAL=1 private project state with actual external Store layout, put unique path/secret-like sentinel text in old failure reason, authored details, and retained evidence body. Exercise valid eligibility, untrusted-failure refusal and missing-details diagnostics. New bilingual reason strings contain only necessary task/card/PR/short-head identifiers and fixed bounded reason categories; never interpolate old reason/detail/evidence text, raw private state paths or repository-specific bodies. Assert sentinel absent from newly emitted wake summaries/public checkout artifacts/generated public metadata, while original private records retain sentinel unchanged and proper private routing. External authored details requirement remains; no self-builder fallback or cross-project record copying. Test both languages and fixture/private-state isolation in existing scoped loop test helper.
